data.name: EncapsulateField_DocumentChanged
data.value: The field was not encapsulated: the document has changed since it was offered. Ask for the encapsulation again.

data.name: EncapsulateFieldRefusal_NotAField
data.value: Encapsulate Field encapsulates a variable of the declarations section of a module, and none is named here.

data.name: EncapsulateFieldRefusal_NotPublic
data.value: '{0}' is not Public: only a Public field is encapsulated.

data.name: EncapsulateFieldRefusal_WithEvents
data.value: '{0}' is declared WithEvents: the procedures named after it handle its events, and a property cannot be declared WithEvents.

data.name: EncapsulateFieldRefusal_NotSupported
data.value: '{0}' is an array, a fixed-length string or a variable declared As New, or its type is not known: the encapsulation writes no properties for it.

data.name: EncapsulateFieldRefusal_Conditional
data.value: '{0}' is declared in a branch of an #If block: it is compiled only when that branch is live, and its properties would always be.

data.name: EncapsulateFieldRefusal_SharesItsLine
data.value: '{0}' shares its line with another statement. Write its declaration on a line of its own first.

data.name: EncapsulateFieldRefusal_DeclarationsConditional
data.value: The declarations section ends in a branch of an #If block, where the type that holds '{0}' would be compiled only when that branch is live.

data.name: EncapsulateFieldRefusal_NameTaken
data.value: '{1}' is already a name of the module.

data.name: EncapsulateFieldRefusal_WritesThroughACopy
data.value: {1} writes '{0}', a user-defined type: through a property, it would write to a copy, and the write would be lost without an error.

data.name: EncapsulateFieldChange_PassedByRef
data.value: {1} passes '{0}' to a parameter that may be ByRef: through a property, what the procedure writes to it is written to a copy, and lost.

data.name: EncapsulateField_NotAccepted
data.value: The encapsulation would change what the code does, and the change was not accepted: {0}

data.name: EncapsulateField_NotVerified
data.value: The field was not encapsulated: it would break the code. {0}
